meta.parties: Weerasooriya Et Al. v. Weerasooriya Et Al

rules.statement: An action by the heirs of a deceased wife to set aside a deed of gift granted by the husband, on the ground that the gift was a fraud on the community, can be maintained even if the wife did not complain during her lifetime.
rules.supporting_quote: "On these authorities Mr. de Sampayo argued (1) that the remedy belonged to the wife alone, and that where, as here, she had not complained, no right of action survived to her heirs; (2) that such an action as the present would only be maintainable where there had been on the husband's part an active intention to defraud the wife of her share of the common property, and that no such intention was disclosed by the evidence;"
